sources.title: Feature Line Rendering from Rasterization States in 3D Gaussian Splatting
sources.read_scope: Both pages; sections 1, 2, 3; equations 1-5; limitations and future work.
sources.quote: The output remains a view-dependent raster field rather than a persistent 3D stroke representation.
sources.method_evidence: Top-K primitive identities and alpha-transmittance contributions remain raster evidence; persistent strokes are future work.
sources.not_established: No fixed editable 3D asset or all-angle silhouette recovery is demonstrated by this preprint.
sources.version_note: Downloaded PDF still contains DOI/ISBN placeholders; official page now has a concrete DOI. These are distinct retrieved records.

sources.read_scope: Full official publication entry; publication date, authors, preprint link, DOI.
sources.evidence: Official page dated 2026-09-20 links the author preprint and DOI 10.1145/3829333.3847934.

sources.title: EdgeGaussians - 3D Edge Mapping via Gaussian Splatting
sources.quote: The 3D Gaussians optimized only with the rendering loss can be oriented and scaled without correlation to the 3D edge geometry.
sources.quote_location: Section 3.2, Learning oriented edge points as Gaussians; web parsed line 101
sources.method_evidence: Edge-supervised retraining plus orientation/shape regularization precedes cluster-then-fit extraction. Appendix C records missed and spurious fitted edges.
sources.not_established: Covariance axes from an unchanged RGB-trained model are not certified edge tangents by this method.

sources.title: 3D Neural Edge Reconstruction
sources.read_scope: Sections 3.1-3.2 and 4.1 including UDF rendering, point shifting/direction/linkage, fitting/merging, dataset scope.
sources.quote: We select 82 CAD models, excluding those containing inconsistent edge observations (e.g., cylinders or balls).
sources.method_evidence: A trained UDF supplies edge distances and gradients before parametric extraction; dataset scope excludes some rolling silhouettes.
sources.not_established: An untrained Gaussian occupancy proxy is not thereby a distance field, and all-view fixed silhouette curves are not established.

sources.read_scope: Project identity and link discovery only. No implementation downloaded or executed.

sources.title: Curve-Aware Gaussian Splatting for 3D Parametric Curve Reconstruction
sources.read_scope: Sections 1, 3.1-3.4, 4.1; curve-Gaussian coupling, width, merging/splitting/pruning, losses.
sources.quote: we initialize the process with random Bézier parameterized curves.
sources.quote_location: Section 3.3 introductory paragraph; web parsed line 128
sources.method_evidence: Curves control Gaussian positions and orientations; training optimizes control points, opacity and thickness with adaptive topology.
sources.not_established: This is not direct selection or fusion of immutable original SH3 Gaussian identities.

sources.read_scope: Full project description and paper link; confirms ICCV 2025 and arXiv identifier.
sources.method_claims_supported: Only as corroboration of primary paper, not replacement for reading it.

sources.title: L1-Medial Skeleton of Point Cloud
sources.read_scope: Abstract and sections 2-4, section 5 limitations; local contraction, branch formation, centering and topology restrictions.
sources.quote: our algorithm may produce skeletons with incorrect topology
sources.quote_location: PDF page 7, Limitations paragraph about close-by surface sheets
sources.method_evidence: Localized median contraction targets the shape's medial curve; nearby sheets can produce wrong topology when only position is available.
sources.not_established: A medial skeleton is not the same target as an external contour band.
